verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents conversions across hundreds of formats, explicitly including videos and audio, so basic audio/video format transcoding is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows user control over codec, bitrate, or resolution, which is the power-user core of this story. Missing for 10: documented codec selection, bitrate control, resolution/scaling parameters, and any list of audio/video format pairs or independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, audio and video transcode between formats with control over codec, bitrate, and resolution

citations.quote: We support 100's of different file formats including documents, videos, images, audio, CAD, eBooks and more.
To convert a file with Zamzar, you need to send a request to the `jobs` endpoint.
